name: Whacked!

features.name: Half-symbol xWays
features.description: Two or four half symbols that pay in full.

review:
A 5x3 mob game where every win loads a bullet into a cylinder – once all six are loaded, the feature fires. xWays expand into two or four half-sized symbols that pay the same as full-size ones, which can add a lot of ways.

Three scatters start Whacked Spins. Watching the cylinder fill up, spin by spin, is half the fun. Extreme volatility, 11,912x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
